jobs.title: NBA Take-Two Executive Producer, Branded Content
jobs.description:
WORK OPTION: The NBA currently provides eligible employees the option of working remotely one day per week.

_________________

Position Overview

We are seeking a visionary and results-driven Executive Producer
to lead our branded content. This role is responsible for overseeing the entire branded content lifecycle—from RFPs and pitches through development, production, post-production, and distribution. The ideal candidate has a strong background in both branded and editorial content, extensive client-facing experience, and the ability to manage a robust slate of branded content across our three brands: NBA 2K League, NBA Take Two, and NBA Research and Development.

Key Responsibilities

Creative Strategy & Development

Collaborate with Creative, Sales, and Marketing on pre-sale custom editorial extensions and branded content, including brainstorms, pitch ideation, talent recommendations, sponsorship concepts, and new content opportunities.
Develop innovative, social-first creative strategies and built-if-sold branded content IP, series, and experiences that align with advertiser objectives, audience interests, cultural trends, and the competitive marketplace.
Provide overarching creative direction across branded content, working in lockstep with the editorial vision to ensure a cohesive, premium brand experience.
Partner with internal creative and editorial teams to develop concepts that are authentic to the brand while delivering meaningful value for advertising partners.

Client & Pitch Leadership

Serve as a senior creative leader throughout the pitch process, translating client objectives into compelling branded content strategies, creative treatments, written proposals, and presentation materials.
Lead and participate in client and agency presentations, confidently articulating the creative vision and getting partners excited, aligned, and bought into the idea.
Act as a creative thought leader within Sales and Marketing, helping shape solutions that balance client objectives with audience and editorial considerations.

Creative Execution & Production

Oversee end-to-end creative execution across branded video, social, custom editorial extensions, and live event content.
Work closely with production and creative teams on post-sale projects, including creative treatments, scripts, social concepts, talent integration, event activations, and other campaign deliverables.
Provide creative direction throughout production and post-production, reviewing and refining treatments, scripts, copy, edits, and final assets to ensure client KPIs and feedback are addressed.
Maintain a strong understanding of talent booking, production budgets, timelines, and logistical considerations to ensure internal talent and production teams are positioned for success.
Travel to shoots and events as the creative lead and on-set representative for the Partnerships team when needed.

Cross-Functional & Deliverables Management

Partner cross-functionally to ensure seamless execution of sold programs.
Own the creative oversight and fulfillment of campaign deliverables, ensuring all assets, talent requirements, approvals, timelines, and client commitments are clearly tracked and delivered.
Serve as a key connective point between the client and internal teams, ensuring expectations, feedback, creative direction, and deliverables remain aligned throughout the campaign lifecycle.
QC and approve final video and creative assets for client, social, editorial, and event use.

Qualifications

10+ years of experience developing and producing custom editorial and/or branded content within a major media publisher, brand, marketing agency, or similar creative organization.
Proven experience leading branded video and digital campaigns from concept through final delivery.
Strong portfolio showcasing video, digital, social, and experiential creative with cultural impact.
Exceptional client-facing and presentation skills, with the ability to sell creative ideas and build excitement among senior partners.
Deep understanding of sports, basketball, gaming, pop culture, social media, and current cultural trends.
Experience managing talent-facing productions and high-profile brand partnerships.
Strong understanding of production budgets, timelines, talent integration, and creative workflows.
Excellent project management, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to balance big-picture creative vision with hands-on execution.
Highly collaborative and comfortable working across multiple functions in a fast-paced media environment.
Sports experience preferred but not required depending on previous experience.
Ability to travel up to 20% of the time.

Take-Two Benefits

Employees and/or eligible dependents may be eligible to participate in the following Company-sponsored employee benefit programs: medical; dental; vision; life/AD&D insurance; short term disability; tax advantaged accounts such as FSA, a 401(k) retirement plan; commuter benefits, and unlimited time off benefits that include vacation and sick time.

Salary Range

$150,000-$170,000

Job Posting Title

Supplemental Staff

Employees currently are eligible to receive an annual discretionary performance bonus, awarded at the sole discretion of the Company and subject to any terms and conditions set by the Company. Employees and/or eligible dependents may be eligible to participate in the following Company-sponsored employee benefit programs: medical; dental; vision; life/AD&D insurance; short- and long-term disability; fertility and family-forming assistance; wellbeing allowance; educational assistance; mental health coaching/therapy; tax advantaged accounts such as HSA and healthcare/dependent care FSAs; a 401(k) retirement plan; and time off benefits that include vacation, sick time, and personal days.

We Consider Applicants For All Positions On The Basis Of Merit, Qualifications And Business Needs, And Without Regard To Race, Color, National Origin, Religion, Sex, Gender Identity, Age, Disability, Alienage Or Citizenship Status, Ancestry, Marital Status, Creed, Genetic Predisposition Or Carrier Status, Sexual Orientation, Veteran Status, Familial Status, Status As A Victim Of Domestic Violence Or Any Other Status Or Characteristic Protected By Applicable Federal, State, Or Local Law.

The NBA is committed to providing a safe and healthy workplace. To safeguard our employees and their families, our visitors, and the broader community from COVID-19, and in consideration of recommendations from health authorities and the NBA’s own advisors, any individual working onsite in our New York and New Jersey offices must be fully vaccinated against COVID-19. The NBA will discuss accommodations for individuals who cannot be vaccinated due to a medical reason or sincerely held religious belief, practice, or observance.

About The NBA

The National Basketball Association (NBA) is a global sports and media organization with the mission to inspire and connect people everywhere through the power of basketball. Built around five professional sports leagues: the NBA, WNBA, NBA G League, NBA 2K League and Basketball Africa League, the NBA has established a major international presence with games and programming available in 214 countries and territories in 60 languages, and merchandise for sale in more than 200 countries and territories on all seven continents. NBA rosters at the start of the 2024-25 season featured a record-tying 125 international players from a record-tying 43 countries. NBA Digital’s assets include NBA TV, NBA.com, the NBA App and NBA League Pass. The NBA has created one of the largest social media communities in the world, with more than 2.3 billion likes and followers globally across all leagues, team and player platforms. NBA Cares, the NBA’s global social responsibility platform, partners with renowned community-based organizations around the world to address important social issues in the areas of education, inclusion, youth and family development, and health and wellness.

jobs.title: Art Director – Droga5 – Dublin, Ireland
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Droga5, the Dublin arm of Accenture Song, is looking for an Art Director who can turn a brief into a stream of sharp, culturally-tuned ideas — and do it fast. In other words, this isn’t a role for someone who wants to sit on one big concept for weeks. Instead, it’s built for a visual thinker who thrives on volume, iteration and self-editing. This person should feel just as comfortable pitching a scrappy social idea as shaping a full brand campaign. Additionally, the role sits across Droga5 Dublin, Song Ireland and the wider D5 Global network. As a result, exposure to international briefs comes with the territory.

About Droga5 / The Team

Droga5 is one of the most decorated creative agencies on the planet. The agency was founded in 2006 and has since been named Agency of the Decade by both Ad Age and Adweek. In fact, it has been crowned Agency of the Year more than 25 times. Today, as part of Accenture Song, Droga5 operates across Dublin, New York, London, Tokyo, São Paulo and Australia/New Zealand. Together, these offices blend integrated communications, experience innovation and business design under one creative roof.

The Dublin creative department describes itself as generous rather than territorial. Team members lean on each other, learn from each other, and measure success by the quality of the last piece of work out the door — not by ego. For an Art Director, this translates into a genuinely collaborative floor. Here, copywriters, fellow art directors and designers work shoulder to shoulder on ideas rather than in silos.

Responsibilities

Ideation & Concept Development

Generate a high volume of ideas quickly, then refine and self-edit as work develops
Package ideas clearly, concisely and in a way that’s easy for clients to say “yes” to
Think in platforms rather than defaulting to traditional advertising formats
Stay a genuine student of trends across advertising, culture, media and social

Craft & Execution

Pull visual references and build comps fast enough to keep pace with client presentations
Set the art direction, style and tone for brand campaigns across every channel
Begin contributing across all stages of production, not just concept

Collaboration & Client Understanding

Work cross-discipline to deliver projects to a high creative standard, on time
Take feedback well and incorporate it without losing the idea’s integrity
Build an early understanding of clients’ businesses and needs
Act as an accountable partner across D5 Dublin, Song Ireland, D5 Global and Song global

Culture & Attitude

Bring outside interests and references into the work (filmmakers, influencers, designers, etc.)
Pitch in wherever needed, with a good attitude

Minimum Qualifications

A portfolio or work samples that demonstrate smart, brand-building ideas and executions

Preferred Qualifications

Strong skills in Google Suite, GenAI tools, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe InDesign and Adobe Illustrator
Collaborative, passionate and self-motivated
Familiar with major social platforms and the creative output each one demands
Solid presentation and public speaking skills
Strong personal organisation, with the ability to extend that discipline across a team
Comfortable multitasking and managing simultaneous projects against tight deadlines in a fast-changing environment

Salary and Benefits

[TO CONFIRM] — the original posting did not disclose a salary band or benefits package. Therefore, candidates should confirm remuneration and benefits directly with Droga5/Accenture during the interview process. [LINK TO FIXED PAGE – Accenture benefits/EEO policy]

How to Apply

Prepare a portfolio or work samples showcasing brand-building ideas and executions
Review the full listing and role details via the original posting

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Does this Art Director role require working solo or as part of a creative team?
Both — the listing explicitly states the role can be filled “as part of a creative team or solo,” so Droga5 is open to candidates who work well independently and those who prefer a paired art director/copywriter setup.

Is this position limited to Droga5 Dublin, or does it involve work across the wider network?
The role is based in Dublin but is described as an “accountable partner and collaborator” across D5 Dublin, Song Ireland, D5 Global and Song global — so exposure to international briefs and cross-market collaboration should be expected.

What software or tools should I be confident using before applying?
Preferred (not mandatory) skills include Google Suite, GenAI tools, and the core Adobe Creative Suite apps — Photoshop, InDesign and Illustrator. The only strict requirement listed is a strong portfolio.

Not Applicable

Full-time

Design, Art/Creative, and Information Technology

jobs.title: Associate Advertising Campaign Manager
jobs.description:
About The Company

Chicory is the leading contextual advertising platform for CPG & grocery, transforming food content into dynamic commerce experiences that take consumers from inspiration to checkout. Our platform reaches 150 million grocery shoppers each month across a network of 7,000+ websites, food blogs, and apps, including The Kitchn, Food Network, MyFitnessPal, and powers 70+ leading retailers through direct integrations and retail media partnerships. By combining engaging media with contextually relevant, brand-safe content, we help CPG brands and retailers connect with consumers in an active mindset during high-intent moments—whether they’re discovering new recipes, planning meals, or building grocery lists. From curiosity to conversion, Chicory enables brands to show up in the moments that matter most, delivering full-funnel outcomes with ease.

Recognized as a 2025 Best Workplace by Inc. Magazine and as a 2023 Fastest-Growing Private Company in America by Inc. 5000, we believe that what sets Chicory apart is our diverse experiences and skillsets coupled with our shared values. Learn more at www.chicory.co.

About The Role

As our Associate Advertising Campaign Manager, you'll help bring digital media campaigns to life for some of the world's leading food, CPG, and agency partners. You’ll partner with teammates cross-functionally to support campaign launches, monitor performance, uncover insights through data, and help deliver exceptional client experiences. This role reports to the Director of Campaign Management.

This is the right role for someone who enjoys solving problems, is energized by data, and wants to build expertise in digital advertising. We'll provide the training, mentorship, and support you need to learn our products, technology, and industry while giving you opportunities to take on increasing ownership as you grow.

Responsibilities

Execute the setup, launch, monitoring, and optimization of digital media campaigns for notable CPG brands, agencies, retailers, and publishers
Monitor campaign performance, investigate performance anomalies, and recommend optimizations backed by campaign data
Prepare reports and communicate campaign insights to internal teams and external partners
Partner with Client Success, Sales, Partnerships, Marketing, and other cross-functional teams to ensure campaigns are delivered successfully
Build expertise in Chicory's advertising solutions, technology, and digital media best practices
Contribute ideas that improve team processes, reporting, and operational efficiency
Assist in troubleshooting campaign delivery, tracking, creative, and measurement issues while partnering with Product, Engineering, and external vendors to resolve them
Develop a strong understanding of how Chicory's advertising products work and proactively seek opportunities to improve campaign outcomes
Build upon team and company culture and act as a champion of Chicory Principles

Qualifications

You have an analytical mindset and enjoy uncovering the "why" behind performance by exploring the data
Genuine curiosity about digital advertising and how campaigns work behind the scenes
You take pride in your attention to detail and appreciate that seemingly small details can meaningfully impact campaign outcomes
Comfortable learning new technologies and adapting to evolving advertising platforms and workflows
Strong organizational and project management instincts and can effectively manage multiple priorities at once
Excellent written and verbal communication and can explain technical concepts to non-technical partners
Strong relationship-building skills and a collaborative approach to working across teams
Comfort using spreadsheet tools to organize and analyze data, including functions such as pivot tables and VLOOKUPs (or a willingness to strengthen these skills)

The base salary range for this position is $50,000 - $60,000 annually.

Location: Remote

Benefits & Perks

Focusing on your health and wellbeing:

Comprehensive healthcare benefits, including dental + vision plans
Flexible paid time off policy for vacation, sick days, mental health days, and more!
14 paid holidays + flexibility to take paid time off for any other holidays you observe
Employer-paid membership to One Medical
Free ClassPass membership

Creating a culture in which you can thrive:

Annual learning & development stipend
Flexible remote and hybrid work style arrangements
Fun and friendly office in NYC stocked with free snacks
Virtual and in-person outings and fun activities with our amazing team
Dog-friendly workplace

Supporting you financially:

Competitive compensation package, including base salary + stock options
Flexible Spending Account (FSA) + Health Spending Account (HSA)
401k retirement plan
Commuter benefits
Discounted pet insurance

Our Philosophy

At Chicory, we know that we are strongest when every person is valued, respected and treated with dignity. We actively put aside assumptions and judgment and work to make space for all points of view. We do serious work but don’t take ourselves too seriously. We consider our playful spirit a competitive advantage to building better relationships and finding the smartest solutions. We produce the best results by hiring smart people and giving them the space, safety and the resources to do their work. We are building a company people love working with and working at.

Our Commitment Statement to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, & Belonging

At Chicory, diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging are key ingredients in our recipe for success. Our diverse experiences, backgrounds, identities, and ways of thinking elevate the level at which we operate; this allows us to innovate in old-school industries by looking not at how things have been done, but how they should be done. We are building a workplace built on merit and equity where every one of us has a voice at the table.

Our Principles

Be Good People: The success of our company is totally dependent on having good, smart people.
Own It: We take pride in our work. When we see a problem, we step up. We hold ourselves, and each other, to the highest standard. We learn from mistakes, admit when we are wrong, and take full responsibility for delivering results, not just for our role, but for the mission.
Separate Your Ego From Your Position: We speak up with conviction, but we stay open to being wrong. Leadership isn’t about winning arguments or defending turf; it’s about serving the mission. We challenge ideas without taking it personally, and we invite feedback without getting defensive. Our goal is the best outcome, not to “be right.”
Find Reality: We pursue truth over comfort. We seek to understand before insisting on being understood. We dig beneath symptoms to uncover root causes, and we challenge assumptions, even our own. Clarity comes from curiosity, not certainty. We don’t settle for surface-level answers. We seek reality, even when it’s inconvenient.
Have a Beginner’s Mind: Just because something has been done a certain way doesn’t mean it’s the best way. We stay curious, challenge assumptions, and question the status quo. We stay innovative by tackling problems from a fresh perspective.
Bias for Action: Speed matters in business. We don’t wait for permission, perfect clarity, or endless alignment. We cut through noise, complexity, and politics to drive progress. When in doubt, we act, learn, and adapt because action beats indecision every time.
Customer Obsessed: Our customers are our North Star. We listen closely, dig deep to understand their needs, and deliver 5-star service at every touchpoint. We build products that actually work: simple, intuitive, and designed to solve real problems.
Above and Beyond: We don’t settle for “good enough,” we aim for exceptional. We go above and beyond what’s expected for our team, our customers, and ourselves. We stay curious and hungry. Every day is an opportunity to get better.
